item.title: Site update, 23 Nov 2026
item.description: New Uses page and this changelog. Tools page: workflow or script? decision helper, a searchable NetSuite glossary, and estimator selections that live in the URL so an estimate can be shared as a link. Keyboard shortcuts on every page. Press ? to see them. Two new notes: five governance mistakes that take down a SuiteScript and what a manufacturing rollout taught me about work orders. Email subscription box for new notes, and richer structured data (FAQ, breadcrumbs, articles) for search engines. Home page loads faster: the hero no longer waits for JavaScript, and the GitHub sections load only when scrolled into view.

item.title: Site update, 20 Nov 2026
item.description: Tools page with a project scope estimator, a SuiteScript governance calculator and an integration map explorer. Site search: ⌘K / Ctrl K or / on any page. Now page and the Ask me anything board. A share preview image for every page, a GitHub contribution heatmap, and filters above the case studies. Notes get a table of contents, reading time and a progress bar. The site can be installed on a phone and read offline. Fixed the phone menu, which had been clipped by the header since October.

item.title: Site update, 18 Nov 2026
item.description: Each case study has its own page with a scroll-driven architecture diagram. Comments on case studies through GitHub Discussions.

item.title: Site update, 17 Nov 2026
item.description: Dark mode, an FAQ on how I work, the Snippets page, an RSS feed, the latest-repos strip, an availability badge and print styles. Services section, downloadable résumé, and Notes with the first article on AI agents and MCP. Lighthouse pass: non-blocking fonts, deferred analytics, ARIA fixes.

item.description: Motion pass: typed title, scroll progress, sliding nav underline, staggered cards and a timeline that draws itself. Compact cards that open a popup for experience, skills, case studies and projects.
